settings.title: Shipping & Returns
settings.content:
Finding the right jeans online can feel risky. We get it.

That’s why most customers find their right fit the first time — and if it’s not quite right, you have 14 days to return your order.

Need another size or style? Exchanges are completely free.

Free shipping on orders over €90 / $100. Once your order is processed, you’ll receive your tracking number by email.

Estimated delivery times:

  • Netherlands & Belgium: 3–5 business days
  • Germany: 3–5 business days
  • United States: 3–6 business days
  • Rest of Europe: 3–6 business days
  • Rest of world: 3–9 business days

    For full details, see our Shipping page.

settings.title: FAQ
settings.content:
How do I measure my waist?
Use a measuring tape and measure around the smallest part of your waist. Keep the tape close to your body, but not tight.

For the best fit, also compare your hip measurement with our size guide.

How do I know CURVJEANS will fit my shape?
CURVJEANS are designed for women who need more room at the hips, thighs and glutes, without a loose waist.

Start with our size guide or take the fit quiz. Still unsure? Message us and we’ll help you choose the right size.

Should I choose my usual size?
Not always. Sizing can vary a lot between denim brands.

For the most accurate fit, measure your waist and hips, then compare them with our size guide. If you’re between sizes, use the fit quiz or contact us before ordering.

Will the jeans stretch out after wearing?
No. CURVJEANS are made with CurveFlex™ denim, designed to stretch with your body and recover after wear.

That means they stay comfortable without sagging or losing shape by the end of the day.

Will they gap at the waist?

CURVJEANS are made with a curve-first fit, so the waistband is designed to stay closer to your waist while giving room through the hips and thighs.

That’s what helps reduce the waist gap many women get with regular jeans.

What's the length of the jeans?
Length depends on the fit and style. You can find the inseam measurements in our size guide.

Still unsure? Contact us with your height and preferred fit, and we’ll help you choose.

What if I order the wrong size?
Most customers find their right fit the first time. If your size is not quite right, you can exchange for another size or style.

Exchanges are free.

What’s your return policy?
You can return your order within 14 days as long as it meets our return conditions.

Final sale or clearance items cannot be returned or exchanged. Full details are available on our returns page.
